comments.author: throw0101a
comments.story: 43K fewer drivers on Manhattan roads after congestion pricing turned on
comments.why: Shows emergency vehicles can work in car-light cities
comments.text: > How do you propose we handle logistics or emergency vehicles? Find the the width of said emergencies vehicles, and then build bike lanes that are a little wider than that: the emergencies vehicles can drive down them quite easily (and cyclists can get out of the way quite quickly). Alternatively, if a city has trams, created segregated rights of way, and the emergency vehicles can use them. * [VIDEO] And less-car-centric areas ≠ no-vehicles-allowed-ever areas.
